quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsubishi Electric semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-11-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: First half (April - September 2025, IFRS): revenue JPY 2,732.5 billion (up JPY 88.9 billion from JPY 2,643.5 billion) despite the stronger yen, led by Infrastructure; operating profit JPY 224.3 billion (up JPY 47.6 billion); operating margin 8.2% (up 1.5 points) on a lower cost-of-sales ratio; profit before tax JPY 253.9 billion; net profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 189.3 billion (up JPY 70.7 billion).
quarterly_data.figure: H1 revenue JPY 2,732.5 billion (+JPY 88.9 billion); operating profit JPY 224.3 billion (+JPY 47.6 billion); operating margin 8.2%; net profit JPY 189.3 billion

quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsubishi Electric semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-11-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Semiconductor & Device segment, first half to September 2025: management states power-semiconductor demand stayed stagnant while demand for optical devices for communications remained firm. Orders fell on lower power semiconductors; revenue was JPY 140,654 million (96% of the prior-year half) - optical devices for communications and power semiconductors for railways and power grew, but power semiconductors for industrial and automotive uses declined; operating profit rose to JPY 24.7 billion on a change in sales mix.
quarterly_data.figure: segment revenue JPY 140,654 million (96%); operating profit JPY 24.7 billion (up)

quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsubishi Electric semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-11-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Other segments, first half to September 2025: Infrastructure revenue JPY 582,338 million (117%) and operating profit JPY 38.8 billion (up JPY 21.8 billion), with energy-systems demand firm on renewable-energy expansion and data-center additions, and orders up on large defense and space projects; Industry & Mobility revenue JPY 800,893 million (flat) and operating profit JPY 55.3 billion (up JPY 11.2 billion) - management states FA-systems demand rose on smartphones and machine tools in China and AI-related semiconductor capital spending in Japan, China and Taiwan; Life revenue JPY 1,143,759 million (104%) and operating profit JPY 92.9 billion (down JPY 6.8 billion); Digital Innovation revenue JPY 71,896 million (105%). First-half R&D spending was JPY 113.7 billion.
quarterly_data.figure: Infrastructure JPY 582,338 million (117%), OP JPY 38.8 billion; Industry & Mobility JPY 800,893 million, OP JPY 55.3 billion; Life JPY 1,143,759 million (104%); H1 R&D JPY 113.7 billion
